The '''Trammis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trammis III/Legends|Trammis III]].
